description: Checks an automation document (ir) with Cosend’s compiler and returns its full report: every error with a JSON pointer into the document and, where one exists, a fix that can be applied. Nothing is written and nothing is deployed. id is the automation the draft belongs to; a brand-new automation gets its id when it is first saved, and saving checks the document the same way. It needs the automations:write permission because it is the authoring tool, though it changes nothing.

id.description: The id in the resource path.

name: validate_automation
title: Check an automation
